pages.title: Piraiba
pages.text: The piraíba ($(o)Brachyplatystoma filamentosum$()), or goliath catfish, is one of the largest catfish of the Amazon and Orinoco basins.$(br2)Adults are dark grey above and white below, with long whiskers, and the biggest reach over 3 metres. Young fish are spotted and have a long thread on their tail fin.$(br2)Fishermen call fish over about 50 kilograms piraíba, and smaller ones filhote, meaning "youngster".
